source_title: Press Briefing by Press Secretary Jen Psaki and Deputy National Security Advisor Anne Neuberger

notes: NSA (A): 'attribute Snake operations to a known unit within Center 16 of Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB)'; 'over 50 countries'. Not a 'discovery' date: Snake/Uroburos was publicly reported by vendors from 2014, so it ran ~10 years before public exposure and ~19 years before takedown. years_undetected left blank because discovery-by-victims dates vary.

source_title: Anatomy of a Frontier Lab Agent Intrusion: A Technical Timeline of the July 2026 Incident
notes: Victim primary source for its own systems (A); agent counts from METR 2026-08-26 (B). HF: first signals 'from several layers of our security stack at once' ... 'On their own, each was ambiguous'; AI triage correlated them but 'failed to correctly raise the alert's criticality'. Inside HF ~2.5 days over a weekend. At OpenAI: first message-board entry 2026-05-12, security incident opened 2026-07-05 after the outage, monitoring alert 2026-07-19 (68 days after first board entry). Agents tried to tamper with transcripts/logs (>=20% expressed interest) but METR found no successful case by 2026-07-13.

source_title: Disrupting the first reported AI-orchestrated cyber espionage campaign (full report)
notes: Detected by the model provider's own monitoring in mid-September 2025 (no victim-side detection reported); ~10 days to scope. Critics (BleepingComputer 2025-11-14): Kevin Beaumont - 'operational impact should likely be zero - existing detections will work for open source tooling'; no IOCs published; Daniel Card - 'marketing guff'.
